children.text: 说出实情。
对她撒谎。

开场 1：“我早该知道不该让那小鬼一个人乱跑。我当着他那块宝贝小墓碑发誓，要是我抓到那小子在摘紫罗兰、背诗，我就把他开除，”马奎兹博士几乎是啐着说出这些话，一边把你们领到山谷的一间补给棚。在村子里搜了一圈毫无结果：只在旅舍他的房间里找到一堆书和伯蒂的皮革挎包。从早上起似乎就没人见过他。

教授打开摇摇晃晃的棚门，从铁钩上取下一盏旧马灯。“找灯油，”她粗声粗气地说。你提到当地人警告夜里不要出门，教授用手杖敲了敲一只空油罐。“那就更该找到伯蒂了。”

一道长长的影子笼罩了你们两人，你转过身，看见蕾切尔嬷嬷的剪影映在夕阳里。“你们晚饭后走得这么急。有什么需要我帮着找的吗？”

调查员们必须做出决定（选择一项）：

• 说出实情。前往 开场 2。

• 对她撒谎。跳到 开场 3。

开场 2：你把严峻的处境讲了一遍，这位老妇人庄重地点了点头。“就像你们初到山谷时我说过的，我们夜里不外出。不过，你那位朋友要是独自留在外面，怕是活不过今晚。”她瞥了一眼马奎兹博士那盏旧提灯。“请收下我的提灯。待在光里，你会发现路要安全得多。”太阳落山时，她把你们领到森林边缘。林间的空气浓稠得不正常，你觉得呼吸都困难，但还是跟着这位嬷嬷往前走。最后，蕾切尔嬷嬷把你们带到一片开阔的旷野，朝幽暗的阴影比了比。“从这里起，你们的命就握在自己手里了。山谷的人会为你们平安归来祈祷。”

朦胧的光点在草甸的蓍草与紫菀上方舞动。蕾切尔嬷嬷指着幽暗的深处。“万不得已的时候，就回到萤火虫那里去。”

• 在战役日志中记录 蕾切尔嬷嬷指了路。

• 在本战役余下的时间里，将 1 枚 [cultist] 标记加入混乱袋。

前往 设置。

开场 3：蕾切尔嬷嬷听完了你那套一戳就破的说辞，点着头。“我明白了。要知道，山谷随时愿意帮忙。祝你勘察顺利。”又寒暄了几句之后，这位嬷嬷便留下你和马奎兹博士去翻找棚子。最后，你们找到一只缺了口的玻璃罐，里面只剩下五分之一罐油。“只要每一滴都省着用，我们就能撑过去，”教授说。你们跟着昏暗的提灯光走进虬曲树林的巨口，朝一条安静的小溪走去，然后继续向上，越走越深地进入黑暗。

最后，你们来到一座塌掉的桥和被藤蔓掩没的鹅卵石路前，那里是一处古老村庄的废墟。头顶的树沙沙作响。“那边有东西，”马奎兹博士举起提灯。一双圆亮的小眼睛反着光，随即迅速消失在昏暗之中。

“小心点，跟紧我。这地方有什么东西都说不准。”

• 在战役日志中记录调查员们迷了路。

• 在本战役余下的时间里，将 1 枚 [elder_thing] 标记加入混乱袋。

children.text: 在本关卡全程中，关卡参考卡上“黑暗等级”下方的资源数量代表夜晚所处的阶段。随着时间流逝，资源会被添加到当前黑暗等级上，游戏会一直进行，直到调查员达到某个特定的黑暗等级，或被击败。森林越暗，其中的陷阱就越致命。当前的黑暗等级本身没有游戏效果；不过，某些遭遇卡效果可能会依据当前黑暗等级而改变，或变得更强。

specialRules.title: 扭曲空洞中的地点相邻

children.text:
在本关卡中，地点会按固定的图案摆放，树林牌库中的新地点会以未揭示面朝上的方式出现在既有地点的相邻位置。在本关卡中，相邻的地点彼此连接。

• 如果某个地点与任何其他地点都没有共享的边，就将其垂直或水平滑动，直到它与最近的地点相邻。

本关卡中的某些卡牌会提及一个称为“追击区域”的区域。追击区域是幕与议程牌库旁边的一个游戏外区域，敌人可以经由卡牌效果进入或离开该区域。一般来说，随着夜晚推进，场上的敌人会移动到追击区域。虽然追击区域属于游戏外，但每当敌人移入或移出追击区域时，它会保留所有标记与附属。

处于追击区域的敌人视为“处于追击中”。处于追击中的敌人视为在游戏外，不能被玩家卡或调查员行动影响。不过，处于追击中的敌人可以经由各种卡牌能力重新进入游戏。

（敌人处于追击中时，忽略这些敌人身上的所有强制效果。处于追击中的敌人身上的毁灭标记计为游戏外，不计入毁灭阈值。）

“吃这个吧，你这狗娘养的！”黑暗里传来一个熟悉的声音。几声枪响打在那头熊柔软、正在脱毛的身体上。熊刚朝右边望去，又一枪便打裂了它的头骨。它痛得尖啸，朝声音的方向冲进灌木丛。更多枪声响起。仿佛过了漫长的一个世纪，朱迪斯·帕克抱着一只流血的手臂从森林里走了出来。你赶忙上前给她包扎，她却摆手不要。“我没事。你没事就好。”朱迪斯得意地笑了笑。“蕾切尔嬷嬷说你可能需要帮手。她还付了我二十块钱，让我出来一趟。”

对朱迪斯·帕克造成 2 点伤害。

在朱迪斯·帕克的笔记中记录 朱迪斯救了你的命。

前往 [codex] 法典 Σ：熊 3

一连串鞭炮从黑暗中飞出。“当心！”一个熟悉的声音喊道。更多鞭炮紧随其后，熊用后腿立起，向后踉跄。希奥从黑暗中出现，抓住你的手，把你拽离了现场。黑暗中某处传来熊的咆哮。“蕾切尔嬷嬷说你们在西部森林里找一个叫比利的人，”希奥上气不接下气地说。“嗯，我总不能让你一个人去。所以我借了席米恩的一些烟花。”你松了一口气，都懒得告诉他那是“伯蒂”，不是“比利”。

对希奥·彼得斯造成 2 点恐惧。

在希奥·彼得斯的笔记中记录 希奥引开了那头熊。

story.title: [codex] 法典 Θ：罗莎·马奎兹博士

children.text:
马奎兹博士拄着手杖，端详一棵枝条盘旋的香脂冷杉。树间闪烁的光点投下微弱的照明；你抬头看去，只见发亮的蓝色节结。“我从没见过这么美的东西，”教授说，掩不住满心的惊叹。片刻之后，她锐利地看向你。“你敢把这话告诉伯蒂，我就跟阿米蒂奇说你死在了勘察途中。”

选择场上的任意一个地点。你可以揭示该地点，忽略其强制效果。
不揭示地点。

story.title: [codex] 法典 Ω：伯蒂·马斯格雷夫

children.text:
“真是进退两难，”伯蒂低声嘟囔。这个年轻人手忙脚乱地掏出笔记本，开始画起来。你告诉他现在不是做自然观察的时候，也不是做自然观察的地方，他点了点头。“哦，不，抱歉。这是地图。不过画得不怎么样——”他画下最后一道线时手在发抖。“我以前来过这里。走这边，”他指着树林深处说。

二者择一（选择一项）：每位调查员获得 1 条线索（从标记池中），或整备山谷提灯支援。
每位调查员获得 1 条线索（从标记池中）。
整备山谷提灯支援。
选择最勇敢的调查员朗读以下内容
承受 1 点肉体创伤并受到 1 点直接伤害。
承受 1 点精神创伤并受到 1 点直接恐惧。

熊 1：你发现一根树枝上挂着一小片撕破的花呢布料，那无疑是伯蒂的。身后传来一阵凄惨而呼哧作响的咳嗽声，伴随着腐烂的气味。你转过身。一头庞大的熊在黑暗中像鬼火一样发着光。这生物背上的一群发光真菌以诡异的冷光照亮了幽暗。那东西咆哮一声，随即冲了过来。

查看放在一边的卡牌。
• 如果朱迪斯·帕克或希奥·彼得斯中有一人放在一边，选择其中一人，将其置于你的控制下放入游戏，并立即结算其法典条目。

• 否则，前往 熊 2。

熊 2：你还没来得及反应，那头熊就用剃刀般锋利的爪子朝你挥来。它把一只巨大的爪子按在你胸口，腐臭而呼哧作响的呼吸淹没了你的感官。随着那东西的重量几乎要压断你的肋骨，你的视野开始变暗。

你必须二者择一（选择一项），然后继续阅读：

• 承受 1 点肉体创伤并受到 1 点直接伤害。

• 承受 1 点精神创伤并受到 1 点直接恐惧。

突然，一声枪响，打裂了那头熊外露的头骨。它痛苦地呜咽，又有两枪打在它柔软、正在脱毛的身体上。那东西发出一声可怜的哼叫，随后融进阴影里。你听见蕾切尔嬷嬷的声音从近处某处传来：“快跑！”

在蕾切尔嬷嬷的笔记中记录 蕾切尔嬷嬷出手了。

前往 熊 3。

熊 3：你逃离现场，钻进一小片垂死的树林，举起提灯，指望能看到那头熊恶鬼般的蓝眼睛在黑暗里反着光。森林死一般寂静，你努力辨认自己的方位。

• 将每个未交战的敌人移动到追击区域。

• 在你的地点以横置状态生成类熊混种敌人，并对其造成 1 点伤害。

• 如果山谷提灯不在调查员的控制下，选择一名调查员控制山谷提灯。

• 将每个空的 黑暗 地点放在一边，以重制树林牌库。为此，执行以下步骤：
• 将放在一边的扭曲空洞地点与 3 张随机西部森林地点一同洗混，作为树林牌库底部的 4 个地点，西部森林面朝上。

• 然后，将所有其他西部森林地点以随机顺序放在上面。树林牌库中的所有卡牌都应只显示西部森林面，使调查员无法分辨哪张是哪张。

• 从树林牌库顶将地点放入游戏，置于调查员所在地点的上、下、左、右。

resolutions.text: 对铁杉岛独特的生态系统有所洞见。
带着受其控制的伯蒂·马斯格雷夫撤退。

children.text:
如果未达成结局（每位调查员都撤退或被击败）：头顶浓密的树冠上，细长如骨的手臂般的枝条像抓握的手一样伸展下来。四周的黑暗深处回荡着奇异的低语，你觉得头晕目眩。你用尽全身力气，踉跄着走到一片黑色湖泊的岸边。渐盈的月亮完美地映在水面上，被泛着异色虹彩、油亮的细丝扭曲。湖对岸，雾中勾勒出一个身影。你朝它呼喊，它便缓缓越过水面朝你走来。当它靠近时，你能从它脸上看到的只有一道咧开的、僵直的笑容。

“老天爷，求你快醒醒！”马奎兹博士把你从噩梦中摇醒。你睁开眼时，她的担忧很快变成了恼火。“你醒了就好。要是连你也丢了，我可没准备好应付那些文书。”你躺在森林边缘一片开花的野地里。当你问起伯蒂，她把一缕散落的头发别到耳后，抬头望向正在破晓的天色。“他没了。我把他弄丢了。”

• 在战役日志中记录 伯蒂在森林中失踪。

• 跳到 结局 3。

结局 1：你从森林里走出，来到一片泛着微光蓝色野花的草甸，细长如骨的手臂般的枝条伸展着，像抓握的手。在压抑的黑暗之后，这片蓝白交织的灿烂地毯几乎让你喘不过气。也许只是你疲惫的脑子在作怪，但那石南与花朵似乎在脉动。“看，”伯蒂用颤抖的手指着。十几根发光的茎秆像漂浮的灯一样立在草甸之上，在月光下闪着微光。“我几乎觉得自己正走在群星之间。我们每个人都像一个小小的神。”他从茎上摘下一枚发光的花苞。“而每一朵这些花，都是一颗更小的星星。”

马奎兹博士一巴掌把那朵花从他手里打掉。“就是这种狗屁诗句害你在森林里迷了路。我们为你冒了生命危险！我要是把这件事从勘察报告里漏掉，你就该谢天谢地了。”教授一条条数落他的过失时，伯蒂羞愧地低下头。可尽管如此，你还是忍不住注意到，马奎兹博士训斥助手的声音里带着关切。你们返回山谷时，天空已因将至的黎明而涌动。

• 在战役日志中记录 伯蒂获救。

• 跳到 结局 3。

结局 2：头顶的树冠压迫下来，密布着无数眼睛和昆虫振翅的烦人声响。你走进一小片洒满月光的空地，听见一声熟悉的干咳：那头熊从你身后的黑暗里龇着牙现了身。伯蒂用一双睁得大大的、清亮的眼睛看着你。“这是我的错。真对不起，给你惹了这么多麻烦。回到山谷以后，替我说句话，好吗？”你还没来得及阻止，伯蒂就从你手里夺过提灯，朝黑暗中大喊：“来吧，你这丑八怪！”

那头熊以咆哮回应。发着光的蓝色孢子散落在它周围的黑暗里，把这生物裹在淡蓝色的光中。伯蒂回应似地壮烈大吼一声，朝它冲了过去。你明白了这个年轻人的牺牲，便借着这份分神悄悄溜走，退到安全的地方。

• 在战役日志中记录 伯蒂在森林中失踪。

• 前往 结局 3。

结局 3：“密斯卡托尼克勘察队，1926年6月。成员：马奎兹、马斯格雷夫等。一次计划外的西部森林夜间探查。当地的动植物在入夜后演化出了高度专门化的行为模式，很可能由极端的昼夜节律与凶猛的捕食行为所决定。环境剧毒。发现了一种与新品种寄生真菌之间此前未知的共生关系。有待进一步观察。”

• 每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验，因为他们对铁杉岛独特的生态系统有所洞见。
• 如果有调查员在控制伯蒂·马斯格雷夫的情况下撤退，每位调查员额外获得 1 点经验。

仅限独立模式。 这片树林从来就没有出路。黑暗合拢过来，而无论那个在树间行走的东西是什么，它都有全世界的时间。

当时的黑暗等级为 [darkness]。你们一共收集了 [clues] 条线索。
Tell the truth.
Lie to her.

Intro 1: “I should have known better than to let that little twit go off on his own. I swear on his precious little grave, if I find that boy plucking violets and reciting poetry, I will have him expelled,” Dr. Marquez almost spits the words as she leads you to one of the Vale’s supply sheds. Searching the village yielded no results: Just a pile of books and Bertie’s leather satchel in his room at the boarding house. Nobody seems to have seen him since the morning.

The professor opens the rickety shed and grabs an old barn lantern from an iron hook. “Look for oil,” she says gruffly. You mention the locals’ warning against going out at night, and the professor raps her cane on an empty oilcan. “All the more reason to find Bertie.”

A long shadow falls across you both, and you turn to see Mother Rachel silhouetted against the sunset. “You all left so quickly after dinner. Is there something I can help you find?”

The investigators must decide (choose one):

• Tell the truth. Proceed to Intro 2.

• Lie to her. Skip to Intro 3.

Intro 2: As you share the dire situation, the elderly woman nods gravely. “As I said when you arrived in the Vale, we do not venture out at night. However, your friend will likely not survive the night if left alone.” She eyes Dr. Marquez’s old lantern. “Please, take my lantern. Stay in the light, and you will find the way much safer.” She leads you to the edge of the forest as the sun sets. The forest air is unnaturally thick, and you find it hard to breathe, but you follow the matron nonetheless. Eventually, Mother Rachel leads you to a broad, open field and gestures to the tenebrous shadows. “From here, you take your lives into your own hands. The people of the Vale will pray for your safe return.”

Hazy lights dance above the meadow’s yarrow and asters. Mother Rachel points into the murky abyss. “If all else fails, return to the fireflies.”

• In your Campaign Log, record Mother Rachel showed the way.

• Add 1 [cultist] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 3: Mother Rachel nods along to your paper-thin story. “I see. Understand that the Vale is here to help. I wish you the best on your survey.” After more polite conversation, the matron leaves you and Dr. Marquez to scour the shed. Finally, you find a chipped mason jar with just a fifth of oil. “We can make it if we portion every bit,” the professor says. You follow the dim lantern light into the maw of gnarled trees toward a quiet stream, then further up and further into the dark.

Eventually, you reach a collapsed bridge and overgrown cobblestones in the ruins of an old village. The trees overhead rustle. “Something’s there,” Dr. Marquez raises her lantern. A pair of beady eyes reflect the light, but quickly vanish in the murk.

“Watch yourself and keep close. There’s no telling what’s out here.”

• In your Campaign Log, record the investigators lost the path.

• Add 1 [elder_thing] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.

Proceed to Setup.

setup.text: Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: The First Day, The Twisted Hollow, The Forest, and Myconids.
Put the Night One Time Marker card into play. Make your own path.
Check your Campaign Log.

If Mother Rachel showed the way: Find the Vale Lantern story asset with the Boon trait and put it into play under the control of an investigator, Lit side faceup. Remove the other Vale Lantern from the game. If there is only 1 investigator, the Vale Lantern does not take up a hand slot during this scenario.

If the investigators lost the path: Find the Vale Lantern story asset without the Boon trait and put it into play under the control of an investigator, Lit side faceup. Remove the other Vale Lantern from the game. If there is only 1 investigator, the Vale Lantern does not take up a hand slot during this scenario.

Set the Twisted Hollow and Glimmering Woods locations aside, out of play (both are the revealed side of a Western Woods location). Then, based on the number of investigators in the game, randomly remove the following from the gathered Western Woods locations:
If there are 1 or 2 investigators, remove 2 locations from the game.
If there are 3 or 4 investigators, remove 1 location from the game.
Check your Campaign Log.
If Mother Rachel showed the way: Put the Glimmering Woods location into play. Each investigator begins play at Glimmering Woods.
If the investigators lost the path: Put a random Western Woods location that has not been set aside into play, ignoring any forced effects. Each investigator begins play at that location.

If it is not already in play, shuffle the set-aside Glimmering Woods location along with each remaining Western Woods location to form the “Woods deck.” Draw the top 4 cards of the Woods deck and put them into play above, below, and to the right and left of the starting location.
Check your Campaign Log and gather each story asset from the Residents encounter set. This set is indicated by the following icon:
If Theo Peters is at Relationship Level 2 or higher, set him aside, out of play.
If Judith Park is at Relationship Level 2 or higher, set her aside, out of play.
Put Dr. Rosa Marquez under the control of an investigator. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot.
Set Bertie Musgrave aside, out of play.
Remove the rest of the Residents encounter set from the game.
Set aside the special agenda: Back to the Vale!
Place 1 resource on the scenario reference card, under “Darkness Level.” For the remainder of the scenario, the number of resources under “Darkness Level” indicates the passage of time.

specialRules.text: Deal 1 damage to each of your assets

children.text: Throughout this scenario, the number of resources under “Darkness Level” on the scenario reference card indicate the current stage of night. As time ticks down, resources are added to the current darkness level, and play continues until the investigators reach a certain darkness level, or are defeated. The darker the forest, the deadlier its snares. The current darkness level has no game effect on its own; however, some encounter card effects may change or become stronger depending on the current darkness level.

specialRules.title: Location Adjacency in The Twisted Hollow

children.text:
During this scenario, locations will be arranged in a set pattern, with new locations from the Woods deck emerging adjacent to existing locations, unrevealed side faceup. During this scenario, adjacent locations are connected to one another.

• If a location ever has no shared edges with another location, slide it vertically or horizontally until it is adjacent to the nearest location.

Some cards in this scenario reference an area called the “pursuit area.” The pursuit area is an out-of-play area next to the act and agenda deck which enemies can enter and leave via card effects. Generally speaking, enemies in play will move to the pursuit area as the night progresses. Although the pursuit area is out of play, whenever an enemy moves to or from the pursuit area, it keeps all tokens and attachments.

Enemies in the pursuit area are considered to be “in pursuit.” Enemies that are in pursuit are considered to be out of play, and cannot be affected by player cards or investigator actions. However, enemies that are in pursuit can re-enter play by a variety of card abilities.

(While enemies are in pursuit, ignore all forced effects on those enemies. Doom on enemies in pursuit is out of play and does not count toward the doom threshold.)

“Eat this, you son of a bitch!” A familiar voice comes from out of the darkness. Several shots impact the bear’s soft, molting body. The bear looks to its right just as another shot cracks its skull. Screeching in pain, it charges into the undergrowth toward the sound. More shots ring out. After what seems like an eternity, Judith Park emerges from the forest clutching a bleeding arm. You rush to dress the wound, but she waves you off. “I’m fine. Just glad you’re alright.” Judith smiles cockily. “Mother Rachel said you might need some help. She also paid me a twenty to come out.”

Deal 2 damage to Judith Park.

In Judith Park’s Notes, record Judith saved your ass.

Proceed to [codex] Codex Σ: The Bear 3

A barrage of firecrackers fly out of the darkness. “Watch out!” shouts a familiar voice. The bear reels back on its hind legs as more firecrackers follow. Theo emerges from the darkness, grabs your hand, and tears away from the scene. The bear roars somewhere in the dark. “Mother Rachel said you were looking for Billy in the Western Woods,” Theo says breathlessly. “And well, I couldn’t let you go it alone. So I borrowed some of Simeon’s fireworks.” You are too relieved to tell him it’s “Bertie” and not “Billy.”

Deal 2 horror to Theo Peters.

In Theo Peters’ Notes, record Theo distracted the Bear.

Proceed to [codex] Codex Σ: The Bear 3

Dr. Marquez leans on her cane as she studies a balsam fir with spiraling branches. Glinting lights in the trees offer faint illumination; looking up, you see shining blue nodes. “I’ve never seen something so beautiful,” the professor says, unable to contain her wonder. A moment later, she looks at you sharply. “Don’t you dare tell Bertie I said that, or I’ll tell Armitage you died on the survey.”

Choose any location in play. You may reveal that location, ignoring its Forced effect.
Do not reveal a location.

“What a predicament,” Bertie mutters under his breath. The young man fumbles with his pocketbook and starts sketching. When you tell him this isn’t the time or place for a nature study, he nods. “Oh no, I apologise. It’s a map. Not a good one, mind you—” his hand shakes as he draws one last line. “I was here before. This is the way,” he points through the trees.

Either (choose one): Each investigator gains 1 clue (from the token pool), or ready the Vale Lantern asset.
Each investigator gains 1 clue (from the token pool).
Ready the Vale Lantern asset.
Choose the bravest investigator to read the following
Suffer 1 physical trauma and take 1 direct damage.
Suffer 1 mental trauma and take 1 direct horror.

The Bear 1: You find a scrap of torn tweed caught on a branch that is unmistakably Bertie’s. A wretched, wheezing cough sounds behind you, accompanied by the scent of rot. You turn around. A hulking bear glows like ghost fire in the darkness. A colony of shimmering fungus on the creature’s back lights up the murk with an eerie incandescence. The creature roars, then charges.

Check the set-aside cards.
• If either Judith Park or Theo Peters are set aside, choose one of them to put into play under your control and immediately resolve their codex entry.

• Otherwise, proceed to The Bear 2.

The Bear 2: Before you can react, the bear swipes at you with razor sharp claws. Its rancid, wheezing breath floods your senses as it presses a gargantuan paw to your chest. Your vision begins to dim as the thing’s weight threatens to snap your ribcage.

You must either (choose one), then continue reading:

• Suffer 1 physical trauma and take 1 direct damage.

• Suffer 1 mental trauma and take 1 direct horror.

Suddenly, a shot rings out, cracking the bear’s exposed skull. It whines in pain as two more shots impact its soft, molting body. The thing lets out a pitiful grunt, then melts into the shadows. You hear Mother Rachel’s voice from somewhere close: “Run!”

In Mother Rachel’s Notes, record Mother Rachel intervened.

Proceed to The Bear 3.

The Bear 3: You flee the scene into a copse of dying trees and hold the lantern up, expecting to see the bear’s ghoulish blue eyes reflected back in the dark. The forest is deathly quiet as you struggle to get your bearings.

• Move each unengaged enemy to the pursuit area.

• Spawn the Ursine Hybrid enemy at your location, exhausted, and deal 1 damage to it.

• If it is not under the control of an investigator, choose an investigator to take control of Vale Lantern.

• Set aside each empty Dark location to remake the Woods deck. To do this, perform the following:
• Shuffle the set-aside Twisted Hollow location with 3 random Western Woods locations together to form the bottom 4 locations of the Woods deck, Western Woods side faceup.

• Then, place all of the other Western Woods locations on top in a random order. All of the cards in the Woods deck should be showing only the Western Woods side, so that the investigators do not know which is which.

• Put locations from the top of the Woods deck into play above, below, and to the left and right of the investigators’ location.

Resigned with Bertie Musgrave under their control.

children.text:
If no resolution was reached (each investigator resigned or was defeated): Long, spindly branches stretch like grasping hands from the thick canopy overhead. You feel light-headed as strange whispers resound from deep in the surrounding dark. Summoning all your strength, you stagger to the edge of a black lake. The waxing moon is perfectly reflected on the surface of the water, distorted by oily, iridescent whisps of a strange color. Across the lake, a figure stands outlined in the mist. You call out to it, and it moves slowly toward you, over the water. As it approaches, all you can see of its face is a wide, rictus grin.

“So help me, please wake up!” Dr. Marquez shakes you awake from the nightmare. Her worry quickly turns to annoyance when you open your eyes. “I’m glad you woke up. I wasn’t prepared for the paperwork if we lost you, too.” You are in a flowering field at the edge of the woods. When you ask about Bertie, she brushes a stray hair behind her ear and looks up at the waking dawn. “He’s gone. I lost him.”

• In your Campaign Log, record Bertie was lost in the woods.

• Skip to Resolution 3.

Resolution 1: Long, spindly branches stretch like grasping hands as you emerge from the forest into a meadow glowing with shimmering blue wildflowers. The sight of the brilliant carpet of blue and white nearly takes your breath away after the oppressive darkness. Perhaps it is just your tired mind, but the heather and flowers seem to pulse. “Look,” Bertie points with a trembling hand. A dozen luminous stalks rise like floating lamps over the meadow, glimmering in the moonlight. “I feel almost as though we are walking amidst the cosmos. That each of us is a little god.” He plucks a glowing bud from its stalk. “And each of these, an even smaller star.”

Dr. Marquez slaps the flower out of his hand. “That poetic drivel is what got you lost in the woods. We risked life and limb for you! You’ll be lucky if I leave this incident out of the survey report.” Bertie hangs his head in shame as the professor lists a litany of woes and misdemeanors. But still, you can’t help but note the concern in Dr. Marquez’s voice as she excoriates her assistant. As you return to the Vale, the sky stirs with the coming dawn.

• In your Campaign Log, record Bertie was rescued.

• Skip to Resolution 3.

Resolution 2: The canopy of trees presses in, filled with myriad eyes and the noisome beating of insect wings. You emerge into a small moonlit clearing to hear a familiar hacking cough: the bear emerges, snarling, from the darkness behind you. Bertie looks at you with wide, clear eyes. “This is my fault. I’m so sorry I caused you so much trouble. Say a word for me back in the Vale, will you?” Before you can intervene, Bertie snatches the lantern out of your hands and shouts into the darkness: “Come on, you ugly git!”

The bear roars in response. Glowing blue spores scatter in the darkness around it, wreathing the creature in pale blue light. Bertie lets out a brave yell in response and barrels toward it. Realizing the young man’s sacrifice, you take advantage of the distraction to slip away and get to safety.

• In your Campaign Log, record Bertie was lost in the woods.

• Proceed to Resolution 3.

Resolution 3: “Miskatonic Survey, June 1926. Members Marquez, Musgrave, et alii. An unplanned foray into the Western Woods, at night. Local flora and fauna have evolved highly specialized behavior patterns after dark, likely dictated by extreme circadian rhythms and aggressive predation. A highly toxic environment. Identified a hitherto unknown symbiosis with a new strain of parasitic fungus. Further observation necessary.”

• Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience as they gain insight into Hemlock Isle’s unique ecosystem.
• Each investigator earns 1 additional experience if an investigator resigned with Bertie Musgrave under their control.

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display. Each investigator may now spend the experience recorded under “Unspent Experience” in your Campaign Log.

• Update your Campaign Log.
• If Ursine Hybrid is in the victory display, record the bear was wounded.

• In the “Areas Surveyed” section of your Campaign Log, check off Western Woods.

• Proceed to Prelude: Dawn of the Second Day.

Standalone Mode only. There was never a way out of these woods. The dark closes over you, and whatever it is that walks between the trees has all the time in the world.
